summary: Optional read-only compiler cache configuration and qualified cache measurements

replay.detail: No graph replay or recovery trigger changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or migrations change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, wire or harness contract changes. The Linux measurement tool supports verified sccache 0.16.0, matching both pinned Rust dev shells.

downtime.detail: No service restart, runner reconfiguration or network access changes. Invalid explicit cache opt-in settings stop dev-shell initialization before compilation.

manual.detail: No action is required with the cache opt-in unset. To opt in, the cache owner must provision an actual read-only endpoint and credential, qualify a distinct unused daemon port, then set ST_SCCACHE_READ_ENDPOINT and ST_SCCACHE_READ_SERVER_PORT. Client READ_ONLY does not replace service-side write denial. Changing flake.nix causes the keyed dev-shell cache to refresh once; existing live daemons are not restarted.

recovery.detail: No runtime or database recovery changes. Unset the opt-in variables in a fresh shell to use the existing compiler-cache configuration; retain the existing local build path during cache outages.
